import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final long INF = (long)1e18;
    
    static long[][] comb = new long[61][61];
    static int R, C;
    static String S;
    
    static long calc(String t) {
        long ans = 0;
        int a = 0, b = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < t.length(); i++) {
            if (t.charAt(i) == 'A') {
                a++;
                ans += (comb[a][R] - comb[a-1][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[b][R]);
            } else {
                b++;
                ans -= (comb[b][R] - comb[b-1][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[a][R]);
            }
        }
        if (a != b) return INF;
        return ans;
    }
    
    static boolean match(String t) {
        for (int i = 0; i < S.length(); i++) {
            if (!(S.charAt(i) == '?' || S.charAt(i) == t.charAt(i))) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    static void init() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        R = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        C = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        S = br.readLine();
        
        comb[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 61; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i-1][j];
                if (j > 0) comb[i][j] += comb[i-1][j-1];
            }
        }
    }
    
    static class Pair {
        long first;
        int second;
        Pair(long first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }
    
    static ArrayList<Pair>[] dpL = new ArrayList[31];
    static ArrayList<Pair>[] dpR = new ArrayList[31];
    
    static void dfsL(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C+1) {
            dpL[a].add(new Pair(p, mask));
            return;
        }
        dfsL(ind+1, a+1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind), 
             p + (comb[a+1][R] - comb[a][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsL(ind+1, a, b+1, mask, 
             p - (comb[b+1][R] - comb[b][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }
    
    static void dfsR(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C+1) {
            dpR[a].add(new Pair(p, mask));
            return;
        }
        dfsR(ind+1, a-1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind), 
             p + (comb[a][R] - comb[a-1][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsR(ind+1, a, b-1, mask, 
             p - (comb[b][R] - comb[b-1][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }
    
    static long ans = 0;
    
    static int rev(int x, int y) {
        int z = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            if ((x & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                z ^= 1 << (y - 1 - i);
            }
        }
        return z;
    }
    
    static long res = 0;
    
    static void check(long x, int t) {
        res++;
        int a = 0, b = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2*C+2; i++) {
            if ((x & (1L << i)) != 0) a++;
            else b++;
            if (a > 0 && b > 0) {
                for (int j = i; j < 2*C+2; j++) {
                    if ((x & (1L << j)) != 0) {
                        if (S.charAt(S.length() - (2*C+2) + j) == 'B') return;
                    } else {
                        if (S.charAt(S.length() - (2*C+2) + j) == 'A') return;
                    }
                }
                int aa = 0, bb = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < S.length() - (2*C+2) + i; j++) {
                    if (S.charAt(j) == 'A') aa++;
                    if (S.charAt(j) == 'B') bb++;
                }
                long tmp = 0;
                if ((x & (1L << i)) != 0) {
                    tmp = comb[R-1-aa+b+R-1-bb][R-1-aa];
                } else {
                    tmp = comb[a+R-1-aa+R-1-bb][a+R-1-aa];
                }
                ans += t * tmp;
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean ok(long x) {
        for (int i = 0; i < C+1; i++) {
            if ((x & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                if (S.charAt(S.length() - C - 1 + i) == 'B') return false;
            } else {
                if (S.charAt(S.length() - C - 1 + i) == 'A') return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) {
            dpL[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            dpR[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        init();
        dfsL(0, R-1, R-1, 0, 0);
        dfsR(0, R+C, R+C, 0, 0);
        
        long dif = INF;
        for (int i = 0; i <= R+C; i++) {
            Collections.sort(dpL[i], (p1, p2) -> Long.compare(p1.first, p2.first));
            Collections.sort(dpR[i], (p1, p2) -> Long.compare(p2.first, p1.first));
            int ind = 0;
            for (Pair t : dpL[i]) {
                while (ind+1 < dpR[i].size() && t.first + dpR[i].get(ind+1).first >= 0) ind++;
                dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t.first + dpR[i].get(ind).first));
                if (ind+1 < dpR[i].size()) {
                    dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t.first + dpR[i].get(ind+1).first));
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= R+C; i++) {
            ArrayList<Pair> z = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Pair t : dpR[i]) {
                if (ok(rev(t.second, C+1))) {
                    z.add(t);
                }
            }
            int l = 0, r = -1;
            for (Pair t : dpL[i]) {
                while (l < z.size() && t.first + z.get(l).first > dif) l++;
                while (r+1 < z.size() && t.first + z.get(r+1).first >= -dif) r++;
                if (l <= r) {
                    check(t.first | ((long)rev(z.get(l).second, C+1) << (C+1)), r - l + 1);
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
